content:
Ava (People Ops): Quick announcement — SF office will run an optional 'Winter Surge' onsite rotation from Mon Jan 10 to Fri Jan 28 to support the product launch. This is optional; teams that need overlap for launch-day support should sign up. :sparkles:
Diego (Office Lead): We're opening the mezzanine and adding ~20 hot desks. Desk reservations via the usual sign-up form: https://forms.redwood.com/winter-onsite (please register by Dec 20).
Maya (Eng): If I come in, is there reimbursement for nearby parking? I usually drive.
Lina (Finance): Yes — local commute reimbursements up to $30/day (tap-to-pay receipts only). Out-of-town teammates: hotel stipend $120/night for up to 5 nights. Submit expenses with the tag `WINTER-ONSITE` and include receipts.
Jon (Facilities): FYI HVAC maintenance in Building A is scheduled for Jan 8 — we confirmed it finishes before the surge, but there may be intermittent morning cooling while they test. We'll keep lobby heaters on and put extra blankets in the kitchen. :thermometer:
Ava (People Ops): Rotation ops: please sign up for a slot if your team needs in-office overlap. Suggested shifts: `AM: 8:30–13:00`, `PM: 12:30–18:00`. Capacity capped at 120/day. If you need guaranteed seating, choose the 'Priority' option on the form and get manager approval.
Diego (Office Lead): I'll create an internal calendar and a short-lived channel #sf-office-ops for day-of announcements. We're running a shuttle (Daly City <-> SF) at 07:50 AM and 06:30 PM — shuttle sign-up on the form (first-come).
Maya (Eng): Can we add a 'workshop week' option? A few teams want to reserve rooms for design reviews and pairing sessions.
Ava (People Ops): Done — there's a 'Workshop' checkbox on the form. Rooms are limited; Ops will confirm room bookings within 48 hours of sign-up.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — People Ops will ping this thread 2 weeks before the sign-up deadline.
Diego (Office Lead): If anything else pops up, DM me or @Ava. :thumbsup:
